reviews.text:
Best place I've never been to. Bought a few things online and price was already great. Meredith and the staff were amazing. So why I can't give a 6 star? The product came and it was the wrong one. Not being in Toronto makes the free shipping great but with the exchange for the right product. That made an issue. Nope. Not with wooftown. They drove themselves down and brought the right product. Come on!!
Highly recommend.

The groomers are really great with nervous dogs! My dog hates getting his nails cut but he’s less nervous to go in every time so I know he’s being treated very well. We usually have Haley but have gotten other groomers here that are also great.

We’ve been ordering dog food deliveries from this company for some time and have always had a great experience. Recently, there was an issue with a very late delivery, and the store handled the matter extremely professionally and promptly. They took the concern seriously, followed up thoroughly, and kept us informed throughout the process. Excellent customer service and accountability — it’s clear they truly care about their customers. Highly recommend!
Greatest pet shop in all of the land. Wholesome treats, great tested products and conscientious owners. Thanks for being in the neighbourhood.
Took my dog for a groom, and the service was amazing
Yukari groomed my 2 cavaliers and did an amazing job!!! She was kind and very friendly with the dogs. She did exactly what I had asked her to do. 2 thumbs up!!

I have made a purchase with them a few times no issues. This time I order and no delivery for 5 days. I called them. Poor customer service they say we try to send it today and was rude. Well guess what you loose my business. You can’t keep your promise of delivering within 48 hours and that is the whole point of this shop for me. I will go to my local store from now on. Poor service

Amazing service !!!

This was my first time using Wooftown in a few years and they did not disappoint...

My dogs were running low on food and the local stores here didn't carry the right food and would take days to a week to deliver. I went online, ordered the food on the Wooftown website and it was delivered the next day... Now THATS service.!!

Highly recommend this store, their website and the fast service of delivery...
Consistant great customer service.
Great store and staff!
Shipping is incredibly fast and free, saves me so much time and an excellent rewards program. Thank you!
Staff super helpful! Great service
I went in with two criteria: damp cat food and made in Canada. This is not difficult. I have bought many brands fulfilling these criteria from other stores. Absolutely none here.
Best groomer for my Yorkie in Toronto!
Have been taking my dog to Ryoko for grooming here for a couple of years now and she always does an amazing job!
Quick delivery and they added a little gift. Thank u! Herc was super excited and loves his new kibble!
Closed on Canada Day but does not update Google.

Wooftown is wonderful , the fastest delivery I have ever had
( pet valu I could wait for a week…) and also you always have a little bonuses , treats for free
Now it’s the shop number one for me, definitely 👍

First time grooming at Wooftown and I could not be happier!!!!!  My dog is older(16) , has skin tags and other small issues that come with being senior. Ryoko did such a wonderful job with a great haircut and the dog came home totally stress free, which has not been the case in the past! I would give 10 stars if I could. Totally recommend!
Thank you for a great service!
Groomer was amazing!!  Best haircut ever for my Oliver.  And the store has the best variety!
Great place to find quality dog food that you won't find elsewhere.
Great service,great prices.
Excellent selection and always such quick delivery. Strong recommend!
